//
// Known divergences between our cpp-msvc demangler and llvm-undname.
// One mangled symbol per line; blank lines and //-comments are ignored.
//
// For each entry the cause of the divergence is noted inline.

// --- Pointer / reference spacing ---
// Our output: "int*"  llvm-undname: "int *"
?foo@@YAXPAH@Z
// Our output: "char const*"  llvm-undname: "char const *"
?bar@@YAXPBD@Z
// Our output: "int&"  llvm-undname: "int &"
?ref@@YAXAAH@Z
// Our output: "char const&"  llvm-undname: "char const &"
?cref@@YAXABD@Z
// Our output: "int& __cdecl Foo::at(void)"  llvm-undname: "int & __cdecl Foo::at(void)"
?at@Foo@@YAAAHXZ
// Our output: "char* __cdecl ..."  llvm-undname: "char * __cdecl ..."
?data@?$basic_string@D@std@@YAPADXZ

// --- Class-type prefix in template arguments ---
// Our output: "std::shared_ptr<Foo>"  llvm-undname: "std::shared_ptr<class Foo>"
?get@?$shared_ptr@VFoo@@@std@@YAXXZ
// Our output: "Foo::operator=(Foo&)"  llvm-undname: "operator=(class Foo &)"
??4Foo@@QEAAXAAV0@@Z

// --- NTTP integer encoding ($0N@ is N+1, not N) ---
// Our output: "std::array<int, 7>"  llvm-undname: "std::array<int, 8>"
// MSVC $07@ encodes value 8 (the digit is offset by 1).
?method@?$array@H$07@std@@YAXXZ

// --- RTTI type descriptor (llvm-undname errors; we succeed) ---
??_R0?AVFoo@@

// --- Template-arg type backrefs (llvm-undname errors; we succeed) ---
// LLVM explicitly does not implement intra-template-arg-list type backrefs.
?fn@?$A@VFoo@@0@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$A@VFoo@@VBar@@0@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$A@VFoo@@VBar@@10@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$A@VFoo@@00@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$A@PAH0@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$A@_W0@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$A@_J0@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$A@HVFoo@@0@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$A@VFoo@@VBar@@VBaz@@012@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$outer@V?$inner@VFoo@@0@@@0@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$A@$07@VFoo@@0@@@YAXXZ
?fn@?$A@VFoo@@VBar@@VBaz@@VQux@@3210@@@YAXXZ

// --- Access qualifier byte mapping ---
// C=protected: our "protected: void __cdecl C::m(void)"  llvm: error
?m@C@@CAAXXZ
// I=private static: our "private: static void __cdecl C::m(void)"  llvm: "protected: void __cdecl C::m(void)"
?m@C@@IAAXXZ
// K=protected static: our "protected: static void __cdecl C::m(void)"  llvm: error
?m@C@@KAAXXZ
// M=public static: our "public: static void __cdecl C::m(void)"  llvm: "protected: virtual void __cdecl C::m(void)"
?m@C@@MAAXXZ

// --- Extended primitive type mapping (_S / _T) ---
// Our _S=char8_t, _T=char16_t; llvm _S=char16_t, _T=decltype(auto)
?fn@@YAX_S@Z
?fn@@YAX_T@Z
